Initial release of Ant Design (antd) skill:

- Enables use of all Ant Design 5.x components within any React 18+ project.
- Provides component usage, props, and best practices support.
- Covers theming, customization, and internationalization features.
- Includes guidance for integrating Ant Design in OpenClaw environments.
